title: The Button
logline: A red button falls from the sky. Zop presses it twice: nothing. Piko presses it properly and a giant beach ball lands on his head.

title: The Last Cookie
logline: One giant cookie lands between them. Both dive, bonk heads, and it rolls off the Edge while a whole pile lands behind them unseen.

title: The Second Peel
logline: Piko smugly steps over the banana peel Zop dropped, turns to the camera to gloat, and slips on another one.

title: Pause
logline: A remote falls. Piko pauses Zop mid-jump and pulls faces at him; Zop grabs the remote and rewinds Piko's fall.

title: Mirror Frame
logline: An empty frame falls. Piko thinks Zop is his reflection; Zop copies every move until he can't.

title: Domino Day
logline: Piko spends ages lining up dominoes around the Pad. Zop sneezes.

title: Photobomb
logline: Piko sets a self-timer camera for the perfect photo; Zop jumps into every shot.

title: Balloon Lift
logline: Zop grabs a bunch of balloons and floats up; Piko grabs his feet; one pop and both drop.

title: Giant Egg
logline: An egg falls; they guard it all day; it hatches a tiny lilac jelly that bounces on their heads.

title: Ice Cream Tower
logline: Zop stacks scoops higher and higher; the tower leans toward Piko.

title: The Spring
logline: A giant spring falls; Zop bounces sky-high and lands on Piko on the third bounce.

title: Musical Chair
logline: One chair falls from the sky; music plays; they circle it; Zop sits first and the chair collapses.

title: Hide and Seek
logline: Piko counts; Zop hides behind a thin pole; Piko walks past him three times.

title: Gravity Off
logline: For five seconds everything on the Pad floats; then gravity comes back.

title: Bubble Wrap
logline: A sheet of bubble wrap falls; popping turns into a dance battle.

title: Trick Candles
logline: Birthday on the Pad: the candles keep relighting and Zop brings a bigger and bigger fan.

title: Copycat Jump
logline: Piko jumps over a box perfectly; Zop copies three times, each worse; the third time he clears it and Piko trips.

title: Rain Cloud
logline: A little cloud rains only on Zop; he swaps places with Piko; the cloud follows Zop.

title: Fake Gift
logline: Zop gives Piko a box; Piko, sure it's a prank, opens it with a long stick; it's a real gift.

title: Sleepy Head
logline: Piko tries to nap; every quiet move Zop makes is louder than the last.

title: Paper Plane
logline: Zop's paper plane always comes back and hits Piko.

title: Painting
logline: Piko paints Zop's portrait; Zop can't stop moving; the portrait becomes modern art.

title: Stuck Jar
logline: Neither can open a jar; Bloop opens it with one bounce.

title: The Hammock
logline: One hammock, two friends: every way they try, they flip out.

title: Snow Day
logline: First snow on the Pad; their snowman looks exactly like Piko; Piko is offended.

title: Tug of War
logline: A rope falls; the winner pulls so hard he flies off the Edge.

title: Teleport Box
logline: A box sends whoever steps in to the other side of the Pad; Zop abuses it, Piko gets stuck halfway.

title: The Itch
logline: Piko can't reach an itch on his back; Zop tries every tool, each more absurd.

title: Magnet
logline: A magnet falls; every falling object now flies to whoever holds it.

title: Shadow Puppets
logline: At sunset Zop makes shadow animals; a huge shadow appears behind them: it's Bloop.
